description: THE FREE TIER — what anyone gets on Rokha each UTC day, read from the one definition the gates enforce. Free, no account: talk to Rokha (about 15 questions a day) and read everything public — the Market, every listing, public runs and traces, the Windsock board — plus 1 Hunt, 2 Mark Checks and 2 web searches a day; no runs (sign in free for 3 runs a day). Free, signed in, every day: about 30 questions, 3 real runs, 3 builds in chat, 1 schedule (daily at most; its fires use the runs), 3 Hunts, 5 Mark Checks, 2 web searches, and a little voice (2000 characters spoken, 10 transcriptions); publish 1 agent, 3 rigs, 2 MCP servers and 3 plain skills in all. The Studio — the Studio month ($249 — card, USDC or $ROKHA) or holding 1M $ROKHA — opens everything, the Edge, the desk and Windsock intel included: 300 runs, 50 Hunts and 100 Mark Checks a day, no publish caps.. Every refusal names both doors. Answers the same day as data under `per_day`; signed in, your own questions and runs left. Public, no login. REST twin: GET /api/free-tier (signed in: GET /api/free-tier/me)
